subject: Interactive Plot App with shiny 0.12.1 and ggplot2 dodge graph

messages.author: fbbf331e34eb7955
messages.subject: Interactive Plot App with shiny 0.12.1 and ggplot2 dodge graph
parts:
Hi everybody,

I've got an issue for selecting a specific part of a graph built with ggplot through the interactive possibility offered by shiny 0.12.1.

The data frame I'm using, named df, is the following:

   aa Pos Freq weight     sign alpha
1   G P20    6  -5.65 negative  keep
2   R P20    2   5.65 positive  keep
3   N P21    2   5.65 positive  keep
4   T P21    6  -5.65 negative  keep
5   G P24    6  -5.65 negative  keep
6   S P24    2   5.65 positive  keep
7   R P27    2   5.65 positive  keep
8   K P27    6  -5.65 negative  keep
9   K P37    3 -12.66 negative  keep
10  I P37    5  12.66 positive  keep

Here is a screen shot of my app:

I want to be able to select only a bar at a time (which correspond to a row of my data frame), nevertheless I always select 2 bars at a time (which means all the row related to value in x-axis):


Can anybody tell how to modify my code to reach my goal ?


Here is my code:


############################################################################

#                                                       Complete Bar App                                                #

############################################################################

library(ggplot2)

library(reshape2)

# Load df

df <- readRDS("df.rds")

# aa Pos Freq weight     sign alpha

# 1   G P20    6  -5.65 negative  keep

# 2   R P20    2   5.65 positive  keep

# 3   N P21    2   5.65 positive  keep

# 4   T P21    6  -5.65 negative  keep

# 5   G P24    6  -5.65 negative  keep

# 6   S P24    2   5.65 positive  keep

# 7   R P27    2   5.65 positive  keep

# 8   K P27    6  -5.65 negative  keep

# 9   K P37    3 -12.66 negative  keep

# 10  I P37    5  12.66 positive  keep


ui <- fluidPage(

  fluidRow(

    column(width = 6,

           plotOutput("plot1", height = 500, width = 800,

                      click = "plot1_click",

                      brush = brushOpts(id = "plot1_brush", direction = "x") # brush only on x dir.

           ),

           actionButton("exclude_toggle", "Toggle bars"),

           actionButton("exclude_reset", "Reset"),

           verbatimTextOutput("excluded_rows")

    )

  )

)


server <- function(input, output) {

  

  # Reactive value for storing which rows have been excluded

  vals <- reactiveValues(

    keeprows = rep(TRUE, nrow(df)) # vector of TRUE and FALSE

  )

  

  # Toggle bars that are clicked

  observeEvent(input$plot1_click, {

    

    # Get the index (TRUE/ FALSE) of the excluded rows

    excluderows <- round(input$plot1_click$x) == as.numeric(df$Pos)

    

    # Update the reactive value vals$keeprows

    vals$keeprows <- xor(vals$keeprows, excluderows)

    

  })

  

  # Toggle bars that are brushed, when button is clicked

  observeEvent(input$exclude_toggle, {

    

    excluderows <- brushedPoints(df, input$plot1_brush, allRows = TRUE)$selected_

    

    vals$keeprows <- xor(vals$keeprows, excluderows)

  })

  

  # Rendering plot1

  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({

    # Identify the kept and excluded bars with column "alpha" in df

    df[vals$keeprows, "alpha"] <- "keep"

    df[!vals$keeprows, "alpha"] <- "exclude"

    

    # Plot dodge graph on Pos

    ggplot(df, aes(x = Pos, y = weight, fill = sign, group = aa, alpha = alpha)) +

      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +

      # guides(fill = FALSE, alpha = FALSE) +

      scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.25, 1), limits = c("exclude", "keep")) +

      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=75, hjust=1)) + # incline x-axis labels for readability

      ggtitle("Weight of the mutated AA per position") +

      xlab(paste("Mutated AA and positions")) +

      ylab("Weight") +

      geom_text(colour = "black",

                aes(y = 0, ymax = max(weight) * 1.05, label = aa),

                position = position_dodge(width = 1),

                size = 3) # Multiplying by 1.05 gives 5% breathing room for annotation and prevent warning

    

  })

  

  # Reset all points

  observeEvent(input$exclude_reset, {

    vals$keeprows <- rep(TRUE, nrow(df))

  })

  

  # Print the rows of the data frame which are excluded

  output$excluded_rows <- renderPrint({

    df[!vals$keeprows, , drop = FALSE]

  })

  

}


shinyApp(ui, server)
